title: A Last good job line in the prompt
compared: Gemma 4 E4B (Q8_0) with the unchanged prompt and with a proposed prompt line that names the last job of the same test that passed. To size the noise, the unchanged prompt was run again on 16 of the jobs.
sample: 32 public gold jobs that have a last good job, 16 product bugs and 16 test issues.

columns.label: Same class as the first run

rows.prompt: with the last good job line

verdict: With the line 14 right against 17 (3 fixed, 6 broken, 2 wrong either way), but the unchanged prompt run again kept its class on only 7 of 16 jobs. No measurable effect.
